{{Quote|I feel a presence in the Force, as if something very old has awakened.|Emperor Palpatine, upon sensing the reawakening of Fornayh's spirit|<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />}}
'''Quorlac Fornayh''' was a male [[Near-Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived over a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the course of a war with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] turned against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Fornayh took shelter at his [[Fornayh's fortress|hidden fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]]. Over the next [[Standard century/Legends|century]], he channelled his efforts into the development of the [[coloi]], a deadly, winged [[mutant]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] his creation was finalized, Fornayh was close to [[Death/Legends|death]] and he stowed his single coloi specimen in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]] before passing away.

The Sith Lord endured afer death in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as a [[Force ghost/Legends|dark side spirit]] and he was awakened when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] were wrecked on Yorgraxx during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Fornayh and his coloi subsequently attacked the crash survivors after they ventured into his fortress and were defeated by the group.

==Biography==
===Career as a Sith Lord===
[[File:Coloi.png|thumb|left|200px|A coloi, the Sith mutant species developed by Fornayh]]
Quorlac Fornayh was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], who served [[Sith Empire (disambiguation)|one of the Sith Empires]] over a [[Millennium/Legends|1000]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], amid a [[Time/Legends|time]] of war between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the rival [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Fornayh established a base of operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]],<ref name="Shadows in the Force" /> located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the world's native [[Unidentified Yorgraxx species|native population]]. He employed his workforce to build a concealed [[Fornayh's fortress|underground fortress]] for his personal use, sited far beneath a high [[Mountain/Legends|mountain range]] and [[Speciecide|exterminated]] the natives once construction of the base was completed. The Sith Lord programmed two [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]] to protect the entrance to his facility on the planetary surface and also kept two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapons with the base, one in his personal quarters and one within the installation's central control room.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

After the tide of the war with the Republic turned against the Sith, Fornayh and many other Sith Lords were forced into hiding. The Near-Human retreated to his stronghold on Yorgraxx to strengthen his forces and began work on the development of the [[coloi]] [[mutant]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]<ref name="Shadows in the Force" /> [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammal]]<ref name="TNEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> that Fornayh schemed to use to seize the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

Over the next [[Standard century/Legends|100 years]], Fornayh refined his mutant creation, utilizing a stock of rancor [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] as he perfected a template coloi. At great effort, Fornayh altered the rancor [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] structure, increasing the creature's intelligence. To allow the mutant to fly he lightened its [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal structure]] and added wings, and to grant it protection, he added [[Color/Legends|black]] metallic plating in place of skin.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

By the time Fornayh had finalized his coloi template, he was close to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Lacking sufficient time to instruct the mutant in the use of [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons or to clone additional rancors to turn into colois, Fornayh placed his single prototype coloi into [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] within a [[Stasis chamber/Legends|stasis unit]] in preparation for his imminent passing. Confident that his essence would live on through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Sith Lord planned to return to life through a clone body after his physical death. He programmed the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] of his Yorgraxx base to activate four [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] in the event of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] landing on the planet, which were then to bring the base back online.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

===Reawakening===
{{Quote|Very interesting.|Emperor Palpatine, upon sensing the reawakening of Fornayh's spirit|<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />}}
[[File:Palpatine4ABY.png|thumb|right|200px|Palpatine, the Imperial leader who sensed Quorlac Fornayh's reawakening]]
Following his demise, Fornayh's consciousness endured as a [[Force ghost/Legends|dark side spirit]], waiting on Yorgraxx for someone to rediscover his base. Over one thousand years later, at some stage after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Predator's Beak]]'', a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] vessel of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], crashed onto Fornayh's planet, triggering automatic reactivation of the Sith Lord's fortress. Fornayh's spirit was awoken, resulting in a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]], and he observed as his labor [[Droid/Legends|droids]] powered up the base's systems. Far across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Imperial leader [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sensed the Near-Human Sith Lord's revival and dispatched the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Jallar Golin]] hand to investigate.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

{{RPG|''[[Shadows in the Force]]''}}
One [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Griffon's Wings]]'' crashed on Yorgraxx and the crew joined forces with two survivors from the stricken Imperial [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], [[Arran Flekk]] and [[Vor Harkass]]. The group were drawn to Fornayh's facility by his dark aura and a Sith [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] alerted him to their approach. The crash survivors penetrated the fortress and Fornayh watched on unseen from the ceiling as they reached a large [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] at the highest point of the Sith Lord's base.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

Determined to stop the Imperials and Rebels from investigating his base, Fornayh roused his specimen coloi. To divert the group's attention, Fornayh conjured several [[Mind trick/Legends|illusory]] [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]] to attack the interlopers, then directed his specimen coloi to ambush the party. In the resulting struggle, the Sith spirit discontinued the sentry droids illusion and combated the crash survivors directly, but was defeated. Following the fight, the Imperials and Rebels continued their investigation of the Sith fortress. Fornayh monitored the group and attempted mind tricks against them to deceive them regarding the contents of his facility, though he refrained from attacking them again.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Fornayh was ambitious and coveted the throne of the Sith, believing that his mastery of the coloi would allow him to secure control of the Sith Empire. He was patient and went into hiding after he judged that fortune had turned against the Sith in the war against the Republic, carefully strengthening his power base on Yorgraxx. Fornayh bided his time, waiting for an opportunity to bring his plans to gain power to fruition, even after his physical death. A ruthless individual, he wiped out the native Yorgraxx population and developed the coloi, a deadly creature that was more dangerous even than Fornayh had planned.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

In his afterlife as a dark side spirit, Fornayh manifested as a shadowy dark figure. He was pleased when the Imperial freighter ''Predator's Beak'' crashed on Yorgraxx and triggered the reactivation of his fortress though he was not keen for the crash survivors to learn about his operations.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

==Powers and abilities==
A skilled [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemist]], Fornayh was adept in the arts of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] and capable manipulating the genetic structure of his test subjects. He was also familiar with the construction of lightsaber weapons. As a Sith Lord, Fornayh was proficient in the use of the Force to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] things, influence the minds of others, [[Telekinesis/Legends|move objects]] and to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] himself. He also was familiar with the [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] [[Battlemind]] and [[Enhance Attribute|Enhance Ability]]. He was [[Language/Legends|bilingual]] and, in addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], he was fluent in [[Sith (language)|Sith]].<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

Following his physical death, in his spirit form Fornayh could hover above the ground and move through solid objects. Though invulnerable to physical attacks, his spirit lost the ability to accomplish Force powers that had physical effects. He had the capacity to possess sentient individuals and if he took control of a person's body, then through them he regained access to the full set of Force powers that he had wielded in life. He could conjure complex illusions and when confronting the Imperial and Rebel crash survivors in his Yorgraxx fortress, he projected several phantom sentry droids. To maximise the realism of his illusion he added the appearance of battle damage to the droids when they came under fire. The effort of maintaining such intricate illusions required all of his focus and he was unable to simultaneously utilize any other Force powers.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quorlac Fornayh featured in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[RPGA]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] module ''[[Shadows in the Force]]'', written by [[Robert Wiese]] and published in [[2004]]. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the crash survivors that Fornayh's spirit encounter and various outcomes are possible. If the player characters immediately destroy a Sith probe droid that finds them, Fornayh is not alerted of their approach to his base, he is otherwise alerted by the droid of their coming. During his fight with the Imperials and Rebels, if his coloi comes close to defeat, Fornayh can attempt to possess one of the player characters. If successful, through his new avatar he immediately summons a lightsaber to wield against his adversaries.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />

''Shadows in the Force'' describes Fornayh as a Near-Human,<ref name="Shadows in the Force" /> a generic term for races similar to baseline Humans,<ref name="SWRPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> and does not specify his [[Species/Legends|species]]. The module also describes him as having served the Sith Empire;<ref name="Shadows in the Force" /> ''Star Wars'' Legends media depicts various iterations of the Sith Empire, including the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and the [[New Sith]] Empire,<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and it is unclear which specific Sith Empire Fornayh was affiliated with.<ref name="Shadows in the Force" />
